person_made_it: Built Sunday night for Gordon's Monday room from the course's own file: his Session 11 blocks, his Wednesday feedback carried forward, the assigned clips named for the first time since August.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The course file speaks (hash in the footer), Gordon speaks in the SAY lines, students write in the notes page; nobody else is on the mic.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: A 10 AM classroom on the packet's paper, dark projector screens for the room, the same palette students met on Wednesday.

works_for_the_recipient: Passes Chromium and WebKit at 1440 and 390 with zero errors and zero horizontal overflow; reads with JavaScript off; PDFs for the printer; noindex.
taught_me_something: Miles is drawn on twos and Peter on ones in the same shot, and the film has no motion blur at all, smears instead; Kaiju No. 8 decided which sequences go 3D at storyboard, which is the portable lesson.
told_me_the_truth: Gwen, Peni and Kingpin frame-rate claims are marked reported, not verified; station windows are time thirds because captions could not be pulled; Session 10 outcomes were never recorded and the guide says so.
weakest: Same visual system as Wednesday by design; the projector screens carry no film stills tonight, so the room relies on the live clips.
